title: Arkiteks United caps comeback with emphatic Aboitiz Cup win

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Arkiteks United closed out its return to the Aboitiz Football Cup in impressive fashion, blanking SportsGen International, 8-0, in the men’s open Division 2 on Sunday, September 27, at the Dynamic Herb-Borromeo Sports Complex. The emphatic victory gave the team a strong finish to its first 11-a-side tournament in 15 years. Arkiteks United placed fourth in a competitive Division 2 field with six points from a 2-0-4 record. The team opened the tournament with a 3-1 win over Magone FC before suffering three straight losses to UP Cebu, 7-0; Lapu-Lapu CFC, 6-1; and San Roque FC, 6-1. […]...
